title: Voices for molen.entities vehicles, aircraft, boats and trains

road.v8.description: A V8: the burble of a muscle car or a full-size pickup.

road.sports.description: A sports car: a high-revving six or V8, loud from outside.

road.hybrid.description: A hybrid: electric at low speed, a four-cylinder under load.

road.electric.description: An electric car: motor whine, tires and wind, and its warning hum.

road.diesel.description: A light diesel: a pickup or a van.

road.truck.description: A heavy diesel: a box truck or a motorhome.

road.tuktuk.description: An auto-rickshaw: a small single-cylinder engine, open sides.

cycle.scooter.description: A scooter or moped: a small two-stroke.

cycle.electric.description: An electric moped, scooter or board.

rail.car.description: A coach or freight car: its wheels, when it leads.

rail.tram.description: A tram or light rail car.

boat.outboard.description: A small boat with an outboard motor.

boat.inboard.description: A fishing boat or a tug: an inboard diesel.

boat.ship.description: A ship or a ferry: a deep engine drone and its horn.

aircraft.jet.fighter.description: A fighter: low-bypass jets with reheat.

aircraft.jet.harrier.description: A Harrier: one vectored Pegasus, no reheat.

aircraft.prop.flat.description: A flat-four or flat-six piston engine and propeller.

aircraft.prop.flat-twin.description: A light twin with flat piston engines.

aircraft.prop.turboprop-large.description: A large turboprop transport or airliner.

aircraft.tiltrotor.description: A tiltrotor: two big turboshafts and prop-rotors.

aircraft.heli.twoblade.description: A two-blade utility helicopter: the Huey's slap.

aircraft.heli.utility.description: A Black Hawk class utility helicopter (a medium helicopter recording pitched down).

aircraft.heli.tandem.description: A tandem-rotor Chinook (two-blade and medium recordings pitched down).
